definition: to follow official rules or laws
example: All clinical and IT departments must strictly comply with data protection regulations.

definition: to make workflows simpler, faster, and more efficient
example: Automating routine checks will help us streamline internal processes.

definition: to make potential dangers or problems less severe
example: Redundant servers are essential to mitigate the risk of unplanned downtime.

definition: a point of delay in a process that slows down the entire system
example: The manual approval step has become a major bottleneck in our workflow.

definition: before a particular time or event (formal)
example: All key users must complete the training prior to the system go-live.
